schema_on_completion.primary_dlval: DL-Val91 policy-mixture panel: contrasts {ARM_minus_r882, ARM_minus_CONTROL, RANDPROJ_minus_SVD_SELECT} with per_seed_gain, median_gain, ci95, positive_seeds, p_one_sided, harm family counts; holm_p (m=2: SVD_SELECT, LASER_SINGLE) and advance (median > +0.002, LCB95 > 0, Holm p < .05, >= 2/3 seeds positive); median_elo, elo_ci95 (r882 = 1500), vs_plateau_best_by_seed
schema_on_completion.secondary_oof: same on the 1,219-context/205-family DL-Train out-of-fold panel (descriptive)
schema_on_completion.fixed_dlval: every fixed policy (RHO*, RAND*, S90-*) on DL-Val91: gain [CI95], families W/T/L, harm families, Elo, vs plateau best 1.1389572 (descriptive)
schema_on_completion.spectral_inventory: per 2-D matrix: shape, full rank, kept rank and Frobenius change per rho (frozen in spectral_inventory.json)
schema_on_completion.full_metrics: sha256 + S3 key of the full metrics.json
schema_on_completion.verdict: ADVANCE iff SVD_SELECT or LASER_SINGLE advances on primary_dlval, else NO_ADVANCE
